metrics.label: Coverage weeks
metrics.description: Number of complete chronological weekly observations represented by the entity.
metrics.coverage_rule: Only complete non-duplicate chronological weeks count.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing coverage invalidates annual labels and promotion.

metrics.label: Mean weekly return
metrics.description: Arithmetic mean of complete weekly net returns after all modeled costs.
metrics.coverage_rule: Report exact observed week count; never relabel a partial mean as annual.
metrics.failure_semantics: Null or non-finite weekly returns invalidate the aggregate.

metrics.label: Compounded annual return
metrics.description: Ordered compounded net return across one complete declared evaluation year.
metrics.denominator: initial equity of the annual path
metrics.coverage_rule: Requires the configured complete annual weekly calendar and chronological order.
metrics.failure_semantics: Use an explicitly labeled observed or projected metric when annual coverage is incomplete.

metrics.label: Mean weekly RAP
metrics.description: Mean weekly risk-adjusted profit using the declared drawdown penalty lambda.
metrics.coverage_rule: Return, drawdown and lambda must come from the same weekly entity and config.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing return, drawdown or lambda invalidates weekly RAP.

metrics.label: Annual RAP
metrics.description: Additive annual risk-adjusted profit across one complete annual weekly path.
metrics.denominator: weekly start equity through each weekly RAP term
metrics.coverage_rule: Requires the configured complete annual weekly calendar; this metric is additive, not compounded.
metrics.failure_semantics: Partial coverage must be labeled observed RAP, never annual RAP.

metrics.label: Mean weekly maximum drawdown
metrics.description: Arithmetic mean of each complete week's peak-to-trough equity drawdown.
metrics.denominator: running peak equity within the week
metrics.coverage_rule: Each week requires an ordered mark-to-market equity path.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing intraperiod equity marks invalidate the drawdown observation.

metrics.label: Full-path maximum drawdown
metrics.description: Largest peak-to-trough drawdown on the ordered multiweek equity path.
metrics.denominator: running peak equity across the complete path
metrics.coverage_rule: Requires ordered contiguous equity observations for the declared scope.
metrics.failure_semantics: A broken or unordered equity path invalidates the metric.

metrics.label: Weekly CVaR 20 percent
metrics.description: Mean return among the worst 20 percent of observed complete weeks.
metrics.coverage_rule: Requires enough complete weeks for the configured minimum tail sample count.
metrics.failure_semantics: Report null with coverage when the tail sample is insufficient.

metrics.label: Trade count
metrics.description: Number of completed logical trade lifecycles in the declared scope.
metrics.coverage_rule: Retries, partial fills and broker transactions do not create additional logical trades.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing lifecycle identity invalidates trade-quality metrics.

metrics.label: Mean weekly portfolio turnover
metrics.description: Mean absolute weekly change in target portfolio weights.
metrics.coverage_rule: Includes transitions to and from cash and unavailable cells.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing prior weights make the affected turnover observation null.

metrics.label: L1 gap-penalized score
metrics.description: Level 1 train-tail and validation score with generalization-gap penalty.
metrics.denominator: initial capital of each compared window
metrics.coverage_rule: Train-tail and validation windows must belong to the same fold and objective definition.
metrics.failure_semantics: Missing either side prevents L1 candidate comparison.
